desc: Derive and prove that any two connected vertices in the disjointness graph have a path of at most three edges.
Formulate the minimum vertex-weighted path query using direct, common-neighbor, and ordered two-intermediate-vertex candidates.
Validate the formulas on both samples and adversarial edge cases, including equal endpoints, nested intervals, isolated vertices, and tied left endpoints.
Design prefix/suffix minimum structures over interval endpoints for all candidate weights.
Produce the final Python implementation with 64-bit-safe arithmetic, input parsing, and complexity analysis.
